title: SOLDOKU
headline:
Sudoku
gets competitive
body:
Create a room • Solve the same grid • Race the clock

Mobile-first Sudoku on Solana
Available on the web and Seeker

title: THE IDEA
headline:
Same puzzle
A new reason to play
body:
Turn a solo puzzle into a shared challenge

Friends enter the same room and solve the same grid
The fastest valid finish climbs the leaderboard
note: Recurring rooms and shared results are our retention hypothesis

title: THREE WAYS TO PLAY
headline: Find your game
body:
CLASSIC  /  Solve at your own pace
Notes, hints, pause and resume

PRACTICE  /  Race a friend
Create a room and share the code

COMPETE  /  Play for the leaderboard
One timed attempt per wallet
note: Classic and Practice need no wallet

title: ON-CHAIN COMPETITION
headline:
Enter together
Race for the pool
body:
Pick a preset or set your own token amount
Confirmed deposits go into Solana escrow

Registration closes → players solve the same grid
The unique fastest valid finish wins the pool
Ties or no finishes return entrants’ stakes
note: Our server verifies play and authorizes settlement  /  Solana holds the tokens

title: PLAY ON SEEKER
headline:
Your game
Your wallet
body:
Soldoku opens wallet requests in Seed Vault
Connect, authorize a message and approve a transaction

Tested on a physical Seeker
Wallet return, background play and cancellation
Saved transactions reconciled before retrying
note: Android hosted web app with Mobile Wallet Adapter  /  Keys stay in the wallet

title: THE LOOP WORKS
headline:
Enter → compete
Claim → play again
body:
Winner test
Two 1-token entries → 2-token prize → empty vault

Refund test
1 token returned → wallet 20 to 21 → empty vault

Scheduled settlement and duplicate-payment checks verified
note: Dated physical Seeker and on-chain receipts are in the public repository

title: WHERE WE ARE
headline:
A working beta
A clear next level
body:
PLAY NOW
Classic, Practice and free competitions

FUNDED FLOW VERIFIED
New entry paused, existing claims and refunds available

NEXT
Fair-play controls, security review and database recovery
Card funding foundations built, provider execution disabled
note: Devnet beta  /  Soldoku tokens have no cash value  /  Mainnet stays off
